name: Canvas Focal Point Widget
description: Visual focal point picker and scale slider for Canvas component image props. Auto-discovers props following the {prefix}_focal_x / {prefix}_focal_y naming convention.
project_description: Widget to set the focal point and image scale per instance within the Canvas (Experience Builder) editor interface. Unlike the classic Focal Point module, which stores one focal point globally on the media entity, this module lets an editor choose a different focal point and scale each time a media item is placed on a Canvas component. It works entirely client-side: a JavaScript behavior overlays a drag-and-drop (and keyboard-accessible) focal-point dot and an optional scale slider on top of a live image thumbnail inside the component instance form, then writes the chosen values back into ordinary numeric component props named {prefix}_focal_x, {prefix}_focal_y and, optionally, {prefix}_scale. Component authors define those props in their Single Directory Component and consume them in Twig (e.g. object-position and transform:scale) to render the crop. No server-side configuration is required; the widget auto-discovers any matching prop pair on the form. Marked work-in-progress / AI-assisted by the maintainer.
